guide.rematter.page.1:
ReMatter Guide

Turn materials into stored substances, then make useful raw materials.

With GuideME installed, use this book for 3D instructions. Sneak-use always opens these basic pages.
guide.rematter.page.2:
First setup

You need Matter Storage, an Analyzer, a Decomposer and a Material Synthesizer.

Place them face-to-face or connect them with Matter Pipes. Use exactly one storage per connected network.
guide.rematter.page.3:
Power

Connect an external FE generator or charged energy storage to each processing machine. Matter Pipes carry matter, not FE.

ReMatter has no survival generator. Storage and Terminal need no FE.
guide.rematter.page.4:
Connecting machines

Place the machines yourself: connected machines must have the same owner.

A network supports up to 64 connected ReMatter machines and pipes. Keep the whole connection in loaded chunks.
guide.rematter.page.5:
Analyze a sample

Put one copper ingot in the Analyzer input. Supply FE and connect storage.

Run the scan. It shows 1,000 units of solid copper and keeps the ingot. The Analyzer pauses after scanning.
guide.rematter.page.6:
The copper loop

Move that ingot to the Decomposer input. When the process finishes, the ingot becomes 1,000 copper units in the linked storage.

Pause the machine after your first item.
guide.rematter.page.7:
Make an ingot

Open the Material Synthesizer. Use the lower-left arrows to choose Copper Ingot, then Run.

It consumes 1,000 copper units and FE. Take the ingot from the output. Pause to stop repeated production.
guide.rematter.page.8:
Keep materials useful

Synthesizers make explicitly allowed raw materials and natural materials.

They do not make plates, wires, gears, circuits, tools, armor or machines. Use normal crafting and other machines for those.
guide.rematter.page.9:
Water in

Use a water bucket on the Decomposer, or enable Automation and supply water by pipe.

Leave the item input empty. Each process stores 1,000 water units from 1,000 mB. The bucket itself is not decomposed.
guide.rematter.page.10:
Electrolysis

Connect and power an Electrolyzer. Select Water electrolysis.

1,000 water units become 1,000 hydrogen units and 500 oxygen units. These gases stay in Matter Storage. Their quantity ratio is 2:1.
guide.rematter.page.11:
Water back

Connect a Chemical Reactor and select Water synthesis.

1,000 hydrogen + 500 oxygen become 1,000 water units.

Then select Water in the Material Synthesizer to fill its tank with 1,000 mB.
guide.rematter.page.12:
Fluids and gases

Take water from the Synthesizer with an empty bucket or a fluid pipe.

A substance amount is not an item stack. Ordinary fluid pipes do not transport stored gases. Gas support needs a specific adapter.
guide.rematter.page.13:
Checking storage

Open Matter Storage or a linked Matter Terminal. Search by name and use the right-hand arrows to browse.

Each entry has an amount and a phase. Different phases of one substance are separate stocks.
guide.rematter.page.14:
Automation

Automation starts off. The owner enables it per machine.

Pipes and hoppers may insert input items and extract output items. They cannot remove upgrades. Fluid access also needs Automation enabled.
guide.rematter.page.15:
Ownership

The player who places a machine owns it. Other players cannot open or mine it.

Enabling Automation permits external pipes to move resources. Only enable it where you trust the connected automation.
guide.rematter.page.16:
Industrial Reactor

Place the controller in the center of a 3 by 3 layer. Fill the other 8 positions with Reactor Casing.

Connect matter and power above or below the controller. The surrounding casings are not ports.
guide.rematter.page.17:
Reactor layout

Top view, one layer:

C C C
C R C
C C C

C = Reactor Casing
R = Industrial Reactor

Twice the base speed.
Same FE per process.
guide.rematter.page.18:
Upgrades

The lower middle slot holds up to four upgrades of one type.

Speed adds throughput and 25% FE cost per upgrade. Efficiency saves 5% FE per upgrade, up to 20%. Changing upgrades restarts current progress.
guide.rematter.page.19:
When work stops

Link storage: check ownership, pipes and exactly one storage.
Needs FE: charge the machine.
Check matter: check input amounts and free capacity.
Output full: clear the output or tank.
Needs casing: finish the ring.
guide.rematter.page.20:
Moving machines

Mining your machine preserves its stored items, matter, fluids and FE in the dropped block. Place it again to continue.

An unfinished process restarts safely. Keep the dropped block safe, like any other valuable item.
